atoms.title: The Trumpet
atoms.b: This is a trumpet. It is made out of brass. In order to play a sound you blow into it. The trumpet belongs to the wind instrument family.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-trumpet-3</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> This is a trumpet. It is made out of brass. In order to play a sound you blow into it. The trumpet belongs to the wind instrument family.

atoms.b: The trumpet has a small mouthpiece where you place your lips, three valves with which you change the pitch, and a large bell where the tone comes out.
atoms.sound:

atoms.title: How do you play a trumpet?
atoms.b: You blow into the trumpet to play a note. The sound is created by blowing with your lips pressed together so that they quickly vibrate open and closed. This vibration passes through the trumpet, and we hear the tone.
atoms.sound: How do you play a trumpet? You blow into the trumpet to play a note. The sound is created by blowing with your lips pressed together so that they quickly vibrate open and closed. This vibration passes through the trumpet, and we hear the tone.

atoms.b: Depending on the speed at which your lips vibrate, you can control the pitch. When  you quickly vibrate your lips, higher notes are played. When you slowly vibrate your lips, a lower note is played. You can make the tone even lower using the valves in the middle of the instrument.
atoms.sound: ssml: Depending on the speed at which your lips vibrate, you can control the pitch. When  you quickly vibrate your lips, higher notes are played. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c4-trumpet</voice> <break time='500ms'/> When you slowly vibrate your lips, a lower note is played. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c3-trumpet</voice> <break time='500ms'/> You can make the tone even lower using the valves in the middle of the instrument.

atoms.b: The volume of the tone depends on how strongly you blow into the trumpet. A louder tone requires more air.
